name: Soft SaaS Pastel
note: The calm B2B default: white canvas, lavender pastel brand color (chroma pinned at 0.09 — pastel means pastel), 0.75rem soft corners, subtle single-direction shadows, Inter everywhere with Geist Mono for numbers. Don't let chroma creep past 0.1 and don't stack more than one shadow layer; this style sells trust through blandness.
